# ui::JumpTask

Header: `winui/ui/JumpList.hpp`.

One entry in the Tasks section of the app's jump list ([ui::set_jump_list()](namespace-ui.md#set_jump_list)): clicking it starts the app again with `arguments` on its command line. [Fill](../layout/fill.md#uifill) it with designated initializers.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `std::string` |  | The entry's text. |
| `arguments` | `std::string` |  | The command line the new start gets, as [ui::command_line()](../core/namespace-ui.md#command_line) then returns it. Quote an argument that has spaces. |
| `description` | `std::string` |  | The tooltip on the entry; empty shows none. |
| `icon` | `WindowIcon` |  | The picture beside the entry; empty uses the executable's own icon. |
